privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.description: This privacy policy describes how {site} handles information when you visit this website.
privacy-policy.intro: This privacy policy describes how {site} handles information when you visit this website.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: This is a static website. We do not require an account or submission of personal information, and we do not directly collect or store personal data.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
paragraphs: When enabled, third-party services may collect information under their own privacy policies.
Advertising partners such as Google AdSense and Adsterra may use cookies to serve relevant ads. Browser settings can control personalized advertising.

Google Analytics may collect usage data such as page views and approximate location. It uses cookies and loads only after you accept the consent banner. Cloudflare Web Analytics is cookieless and collects aggregate page-view data.
Cloudflare may process basic request data for security and performance when hosting the site.
When comments are enabled, giscus.app loads an embedded GitHub view that exposes IP and browser information to the service. GitHub handles sign-in under its own privacy policy.
Video pages load thumbnails from i.ytimg.com. Pressing play loads the player from youtube-nocookie.com. No YouTube cookies are set before interaction.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: Some third-party services set cookies. You can control cookies through browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect ad personalization but will not prevent access to site content.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: This site is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
